scientific_integrity: General validity is supported by exact algebraic inequalities; finite fraction-arithmetic examples provide reproducible diagnostics, not proof of the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Positive conductances on a star, noise-free fixed-budget leaders and the unnormalized inverse-square grounded Laplacian only; does not apply to general topologies, finite-gain leaders or inverse powers other than two. Literature comparisons are not proof of global priority; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact inverse-square leader placement on weighted stars and Pell-type ties
